title: POLY VISION MUSEUM OPEN
lines: DETAILS: Poly Vision Museum will be open for a limited time. During the event, players can complete event stages to obtain Point Card, and increase the level of [Exchange Counter] to obtain event rewards.
REWARDS: Home Screen UI [Poly Vision], Event Icon 'Game Clear', Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, etc.
Please refer to the official introduction for more details.
DETAILS: During the event, players can claim special rewards, including: Orundum, Emergency Sanity Concentrate, LMD, etc. These rewards will be sent via in-game mail.
Contents: Module Data Block * 1, Furniture Part * 300
Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
CONTENTS: Orundum * 800, Icon 'This you?' * 1, Icon 'Chongyue Chronicles' * 1, Icon 'Cut!' * 1
The profile theme can be viewed and used in Profile.
04 CROSSOVER COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
CROSSOVER Collection - All-Round Actor for Chongyue
CROSSOVER Collection - Thunderbolt Director for Nian
CROSSOVER Collection - 'Ride to Davistown' for Jessica the Liberated
[Outfit Voucher] cannot be used to redeem the above outfits.

The English voiceover for CROSSOVER Collection - All-Round Actor for Chongyue is currently unavailable. The missing English voicelines will be added in future updates. Please stay tuned for further announcements regarding the release timeline.
